[project]
name = "blp-streamlit-pipeline"
version = "1.0.0"
description = ""
authors = []

readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.15"
dependencies = [
    "numpy (>=2.3.4,<3.0.0)",
    "scipy (>=1.16.3,<2.0.0)",
    "opencv-python (>=4.11.0.86,<5.0.0.0)",
    "streamlit (>=1.51.0,<2.0.0)",
    "onnxruntime (>=1.23.2,<2.0.0)",
    "streamlit-image-coordinates (>=0.4.0,<0.5.0)",
    "streamlit-image-zoom (>=0.0.4,<0.0.5)",
    "streamlit-container-width (>=1.0.3,<2.0.0)",
    "contextily",
    "svgpathtools",
    "geopandas",
    "pdf2image (>=1.17.0,<2.0.0)",
    "paddleocr (==3.3.2)",
    "paddlepaddle (==3.2.2)",
    "draw-image-mask",
]

[tool.poetry.dependencies]
draw-image-mask = { path = "./blp_streamlit_pipeline/src/ext/streamlit-draw-image-mask"}

[tool.isort]
profile = "black"
src_paths = ["blp_streamlit_pipeline/src"]

[build-system]
requires = ["poetry-core>=2.0.0,<3.0.0"]
build-backend = "poetry.core.masonry.api"
